home.heroDescription: Your guests upload blessings and photos, and we design everything into a printed book that lasts forever.
home.howSubtitle: Three simple steps to your perfect book
home.step1Desc: Send guests a link or QR — on WhatsApp, on the invitation, or on a sign at the venue.
home.step2Desc: Guests photograph and write blessings straight from their phone — no app needed.
home.step3Desc: Design the book in an easy interface and receive a printed book at home.
home.whySubtitle: Everything to keep your memories beautiful, organized, and forever
home.feat1Desc: Guests open a link on their phone — no download, no signup.
home.feat2Desc: Pick a cover, colors, fonts, and frames — everything under your control.
home.feat3Desc: Hardcover book, premium paper — like a professional studio.
home.feat4Desc: Edit, reorder, and remove blessings before printing.
home.bottomCtaSubtitle: Start free and let your guests help you build a memory that lasts.
